info.description: A source path that should resolve somewhere else. Exists because `path` is editable: the first time marketing renames a page, every inbound link and every indexed URL points at a 404 unless something issues a redirect. A client-side router redirect does not pass link equity and is invisible to a crawler that never runs JS, so this is consumed by the server/edge layer, not by the Angular router. Published state is the on/off switch — unpublish to disable a redirect without losing the record of it.
